# carbon.carrierinit { #cflowdist.carbon.carrierinit }

```python
carbon.carrierinit(tracer)
```

Initialize the carbon carrier intensity data for the given tracer.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type         | Description               | Default    |
|--------|--------------|---------------------------|------------|
| tracer | CarbonTracer | The carbon tracer object. | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type         | Description                                                           |
|--------|--------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | pd.DataFrame | A DataFrame containing the initialized carbon carrier intensity data. |
